notes.title: Play on Mobile
notes.content:
[h2]You can now sign in with your Steam account on mobile![/h2][p][/p][p]1. On your Android or iOS device, go to [url="https://tuggowar.io"]https://tuggowar.io[/url] in your favorite browser.[/p][p]2. Click on the Account tab.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/2ad8ac3b6ed006ba66c127e61e7bec8b952c563c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]3. Sign in with your Steam account.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/b8eab426faa8671f7372e22c217c235d3c2de523.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That's it! You can now play with the same account on mobile and even resume games you started on your PC or vice versa!

[i]we don't collect any of your Steam data, we only verify ownership of Tuggowar.[/i]
[/p][h3]Add to homescreen (optional)[/h3][p]On Chrome for Android and Safari for iOS you can add Tuggowar to your homescreen for a nice full screen experience (See Battles tab in the menu or install via your browser).
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/36f228382f7b0701412c0419d9bd651df1dd3285.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Expansion: Arsenal Management
notes.content:
[p]Expansion pack #8 highlights the most important aspect of Tuggowar – managing your arsenal, a.k.a. your deck. Mastery over what goes in and what comes out is essential, and that is exactly what you get here.[/p][p]There is a catch though: These cards are [b]some of the most complex[/b] in the game thus far, and require mastery in and of themselves. Luckily, learning is half the fun![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3880380/Tuggowar__Arsenal_Management/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Spring Cleaning[/h3][p]Divest lets you clean all the Coal from your deck in one fell swoop, in theory.
It's also the first card to give you [b]Production[/b] every time you play it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/7dc15e3fc1054b1dcb729581bdcfddb9ff905dad.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]No You Don't[/h3][p]Want to stop those pesky Explosives? Want to finally stop that Rocketeer from touching your Creepy B? Join the Protectionist club![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/06bc14c1f3eeb26871d938c37b9edaf435b3995f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Final Version[/h3][p]Update just got an update... and it's a major one. Support this and you get one of the most powerful effects in the game. This is a great investment for a reason.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/3aef6ff0b138ebd5eafe504e46c516aed3e60188.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: New Expansion: Mob Rule
notes.content:
[p]Expansion pack #7 lets you solicit help from [b]the underground[/b]. The underground is not that concerned with who you are, though — or who this enemy is you keep mentioning.
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3832990/Tuggowar__Mob_Rule/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This expansion introduces new ways to [b]interact[/b] with the enemy, has 2 cool new [b]Units[/b], and 2 cards that care about things blowing up.[/p][h3]
Dubious[/h3][p]See? Just some friendly folk with a helping hand. No Questions Asked is a [b]Tier 1 Event card[/b], so you can use it right away on the first turn of the game to kick-start your strat! It's basically all upside. Trust me.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/41423099af749babf2ff65e24dc5f728bf481e80.png"][/img][/p][h3]Radical[/h3][p]These guys have no pretense of helping you, they're just here to see stuff blow up. Just  point them north on the map and watch the fireworks!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/c5f8b927e23ca3911f5d5560730fcf0e14d74f85.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Mission Objectives & Steam Achievements
notes.content:
[h3]30 New missions[/h3][p]Every expansion pack now has 5 missions, each one showcasing one of the cards. These missions each feature several [b]optional objectives[/b] ranging from bronze (basic) to platinum (very challenging). [/p][p]Aside from varying objective difficulty, the missions itself can be played in 5 difficulty settings.[/p][p][/p][h3]Objectives[/h3][p]The objective for these objectives is to be [b]fun and challenging[/b], but also to guide you through the more [b]advanced strategies[/b] that are available in Tuggowar. Some tell you directly how to accomplish them while others can be a bit more puzzling![/p][p][/p][h3]94 Steam achievements[/h3][p]When you beat a mission, each accomplished objective [b]unlocks a Steam achievement[/b]! 
Of course more achievements will be added with each new expansion pack, but also achievements for the base game will be added in a future update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]I hope you enjoy this update, let us know what you think![/b][/p]

notes.title: New Expansion: Money Talks
notes.content:
Expansion pack #6 is the second Money expansion and helps you set up some insane turns! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3765270/Tuggowar__Money_Talks/

This expansion combines many existing mechanics in new ways. It has a card that discounts ALL the Tier cards, 2 new ways to Jump-start cards, Double Strike, a Tactical that lets you convert Money into card draw, and much more!

[h2]Objectives & Achievements[/h2]
All Expansions include 5 new missions that show-case the new cards.
The new missions now feature fun objectives with the new cards that also unlock Steam achievements!
All previous Expansions will also get objectives and achievements, stay tuned...

[h3]Embrace the Change[/h3]

When you've played a couple of these guys, you'll feel like a kid in a candy shop! Unlike Broker, it even draws a card, so this is not a big stretch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/47ef96ecaa765c80d016297894f8eb4f140220df.png[/img]

[h3]Reap the Dividends[/h3]

Dividend will make your life a lot easier. One of these will already give you 2 Money thanks to the Double Strike. But what's even better is that it's Jump-started when you buy it, giving you Money straight away. It encourages you to buy, and also to sell, as it gives you a nice exit bonus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/d52791e9b0a3d3141226953ed554e12dca6c794d.png[/img]

[h3]Going Rogue[/h3]

Drawing 3 cards was never easier. Make sure to keep some Money around and you will not regret buying this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/e7d1bc2cf1a604aade701e9bd842c4afe0b8608f.png[/img]

notes.title: Balance patch
notes.content:
Tuggowar is really balanced already, at least that is what you all are telling us :)
Of course the only way to keep it that way is to have semi-regular balance patches!

In my experience these are also nice to shake things up a bit and keep things interesting between content releases, so hopefully you will enjoy them as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/6f74dcf54e9a8881c82ea3d8b7439485eca4e3d1.png[/img]

notes.title: New Expansion: Spy Service
notes.content:
[h3]Gain an advantage by scouting hidden information... and exploit knowing exactly what the Enemy is up to. [/h3]

The latest expansion includes 3 new Buildings, so the map is more important than ever. It also features 3 cards with Rotate, a very popular mechanic from the Base set.

[h3]What's a base without a Radar?[/h3]
As soon as you build a Radar, you have full vision on the enemy's exact building placement and how fast their units are coming at you. With a free Inform as well, their other secrets aren’t safe for long either. Radar rotates into a new Tier 1 card when you buy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/64fe0d612f796b42387ca22ecc26ba31e19da1f0.png[/img]

[h3]Next level diplomacy[/h3]
Embassy is a very powerful Building with Build time 6. Keep a close watch on what the Enemy is doing to make sure your embassies build faster. This will also ensure you have plenty of options to Counterfeit, making it stronger and stronger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/ed0216777560b0a8eb118f68d9c997084b3caaf2.png[/img]

[h3]Reveal all the things![/h3]
Any serious superpower needs its own Intelligence Agency. This agency doesn't let you know the enemy's previous move; it lets you anticipate their next one. It even scouts cards that would otherwise never have been revealed!

All cards in this expansion are Intel cards. And conveniently: so are Disrupt and Counterfeit. With a full enemy shop to choose from, counterfeiting any card for only 1 energy feels like it should be illegal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/f8a7895bba327bafd3bae5fce7c9d0f3be2c3495.png[/img]

notes.title: Match making update
notes.content:
[h3]100% optional ranked bots[/h3]
For new players it's not always possible to find a ranked match right away. We didn't want to add bots to ranked because this is not why you queue for PvP. But we think we found a way to solve the core issue while keeping it a 100% optional. 

[h3]This is how it works[/h3]
When you queue for ranked as a Bronze or Silver player, if you don't find a match in about 1 minute you get an invite from a ranked bot. If you decline you will stay in the queue. If you accept you can rank up to Silver or Gold rank where it will be easier to find real matches!

[h3]More details[/h3]
[list]
[*] there are different bots with their own rank and unique play style
[*] just like in normal PvP you will get extra coins and VP rewards
[*] you will not get the invite when you play a standard AI match while in the queue
[/list]

notes.title: Meddling with Medals
notes.content:
These changes make everything much more intuitive and streamlined. I will explain the system as a whole in more detail below.
[list]
[*] Reduced strength: Medal multipliers are now: Silver: 1x, Gold: 5x, Super: 10x, Ban: -9x.
[*] Everyone now has a Silver medal for each card they own and collects Gold medals as before.
[*] Having no medals on a card is no longer an option, as it was a source of confusion.
[*] AI no longer has medals
[*] Playing the Expansion missions (DLC) now rewards both the Expansion Gold medal and a Base set Gold medal 
[/list]

[h3]What are Medals, and what do they do?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/14d1cfa80a0816af720d12470384a5cc506951cd.png[/img]
Let's start with Silver medals. By default, you have a Silver medal on each card you own. When you play a match vs AI, this means you bring all your cards with a 1x multiplier. Each card then has an equal chance to get selected for your Shop, and the same for the AI's Shop. 

In PvP it works similarly, except now there are 2 sets of medals that get combined, your set and the enemy's set. An example:
Let's say you have only the Base game and your enemy has DLC. Then a Base set card, like Tanya, will have 2 medals and thus a 2x multiplier. A DLC card, like Scientist, will have 1 medal and thus a 1x multiplier. This means for both of your Shops, Tanya is 2x more likely to be selected than Scientist. 

[h3]What this does for the game:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Everyone has the same fair chance, even if you have a small collection.
[*] You can sometimes play with cards you don't have
[*] You are more likely to play with cards you are familiar with
[/list]

OK, those are the basics. If you understand how that works, the only extra thing is that there are different types of medals that have different multipliers. Gold medals are the next type of medal you will get.

[h3]Gold Medals[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/e42a6c0708bd831487672a5218b8706f068fa7b4.png[/img]
Where Silver medals have a 1x multiplier, Gold Medals have a 5x multiplier, which is a big step up. Let's start with how you get them. Every time you win a match, you will get a Gold medal for a Base set card, so eventually you will have all 40 of them. For the DLC, there is a mission for each card that you can play to collect the Gold medal for that card. You can find these missions in the Collect menu. If you only play PvP, you will get them after you collected all the Base set ones.

[h3]What should I do with these medals?[/h3]
Now that you have both Silver medals and Gold medals, you can choose for each card which one you want to use.
I would say there are 3 main ways to use your medals:
[olist]
[*] Select all Gold medals. This makes for the most variety, and is a good default.
[*] Select all Gold medals you have, and put a Silver medal on cards you don't like very much.
[*] Select all Silver medals, and put a Gold medal on cards you really want to play with.
[/olist]

[h3]Special Medals[/h3]
To round up, there are two more types of medals: Super medals and Ban medals.
Super medals give you even more control over what shows up in your matches, with a multiplier of 15x.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/003f51016281a4de693e6fd4d51e12ebd062dd42.png[/img]
Ban medals can be used on cards you really dislike, with a multiplier of -14x you will basically never see them in your matches. You will get these medals as rewards for leveling up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/85d58f3268e4004b405c19c74184e63bebd74c28.png[/img]

I hope that helps! If you have any questions, feel free to ask in the Steam community, or on Discord.

notes.title: Inform and Map changes
notes.content:
Exciting news y'all, we’re getting close to the Q1 release of Tuggowar!

That's why we’re announcing the last major gameplay changes. Let's give these a thorough test!

[h3]Honey, I shrunk the map[/h3]
The map now has 25 lands instead of 30. We felt aggro could use a buff and this makes for a better UX on Steam Deck! We’ve introduced some balancing factors though. Nation & Superpower now have 1 defense…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/1b6a61d781967e671c0daf0c35c5b31d4b547978.png[/img]

...and several Base set cards have been reworked accordingly:
[list]
[*] Tech Race costs 4 energy (was 3).
[*] Combat Drone has Cooldown 2 (was 0).
[*] Nuclear Missile has Build time 3 (was 4).
[/list]
[h3]Heightened mind games[/h3]
The information game has been tweaked. Inform still scouts the enemy's location, but not the lands itself, making it easier to hide bases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/a203c0c1f56ac9a4bc26db8bacbb4d2b9d83ddd2.png[/img]

Interestingly, Inform is no longer a hidden event. So the enemy now knows when you know what they know, and the other way around 😉 By keeping tabs on Informs throughout a match you’ll be able to establish a game sense of your opponent’s strategic knowledge. Do they inform a lot or a little? Can you maybe sneak in a Nuclear Missile??!!

[h3]AI alignment[/h3]
After community feedback the AI has been tuned to play less aggressively. The Hard AI has received a major update as well, particularly to better deal with the 5 card max.

Want to discuss these changes, join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/bWn2P6y]Discord[/url].

notes.title: The pure fun of deckbuilding
notes.content:
Bringing down the number of Coal down to 5 in the starting deck has put the pure fun of deckbuilding center stage. Your buys show up sooner and you get to play with your deck longer. What’s not to love?!

Today we’re taking it a step further. We're juicing up the base set by boosting the variety of card effects. Starting with a new card called Broker!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/fb44f3fa3eaa5b05b50cf6c06de0218afdac8c68.png[/img]

Broker brings a unique cost reduction effect to the base set. Quickly stock up on some sweet supportable Action cards or push with Units. There's also potential for some epic finishing moves! 😉

Next, we're moving Watermill to the base set. It introduces some sweet new combo and counter options. Can you find them all?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/51279bd1d17f18f1b618007140a997e574217d0d.png[/img]

The other side of the coin is removing some effects that were a bit too dominant. As mentioned by the community, too many games involved a Windmill chain. We got it, it’s gone as a shop card. You can still make Windmill decks of course using Carbon Tax or by capturing a Lowland (+Double Down?!).    

Clean-up cards were used a lot and often the target of an instant Counterfeit. We also felt clean-up is not as necessary with less junk in the starting deck. That's why we’ve removed Repurpose (but it will return in an expansion 😉) and moved Manage Arsenal to Tier 2.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/a7aaa9ac75e628804a41cb38f6b920ed0f3bdd24.png[/img]

Finally, there are some other balance changes based on the most recent stats and insights:
[list]
[*] Refuel no longer gives +Energy.
[*] Shopkeeper now adds card of cost 5 or less (up from 4).
[*] Energy Upgrade has Cooldown 3 (down from 5).
[*] Master Tactician now looks for 5 different Actions/Units (up from 4).
[/list]
Enjoy!

Wanna discuss these changes? Join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/bWn2P6y]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Core update
notes.content:
We're always looking to improve Tuggowar, and sometimes changes reach into the core of the game. 

The fun of Tuggowar is in adding cards to your deck and getting to play them, and we wanted this to happen faster. We think these changes will make the game more accessible and more fun in general! 
[list]
[*] The starting deck now has 5 Coal (down from 7).
[*] The MAX for all cards is now 5 copies (down from 7).
[*] Bank is now available to all players. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/bec8753c2bbe371fce2cac9205d64ad21a66e221.png[/img]

We received feedback from the community that having different cards from your enemy in PvP doesn't feel fair.
We believe this is how Tuggowar is the most fun, but we will let you decide what feels best to you!

Mirror Mode takes a more prominent role and is the default for new players, in Mirror Mode...
[list]
[*] You play with the exact same starting Shop as your Enemy.
[*] Each Tier has 4 cards instead of 3. 
[*] When one player has Mirror Mode on and the other doesn't, it will be 50/50. 
[/list]

Finally, Field Howitzer is renamed to Rocketeer and got a new look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939328/b3c3d00c884545459be2331fb0e573eabd8025a2.png[/img]
